summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of Firebase social platform. UI/UX working well with glassmorphism design. Critical authentication persistence issue identified.

integration_issues.issue: User sessions not persisting between page loads/navigation - users get logged out unexpectedly
Posts not appearing in feed after creation - Firebase write operations may be failing
Admin functionality only works for specific UID (48VUvApl8PWC8KhcKEqgfVS87wB2) - new admin accounts don't get privileges

passed_tests: Login page loads with glassmorphism UI and cyberpunk background
Signup form creates new users in Firebase Auth
Feed page UI loads correctly with post creation box
Admin route protection works (redirects non-admins to login)
Form inputs are accessible and focusable on all screen sizes
UI styling and glassmorphism effects render properly
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix Firebase authentication persistence issue - users are getting logged out between page navigations. Check Firebase project settings, auth configuration, and AuthContext implementation. Also investigate post creation Firebase write operations.
